integrity: The homotopy and filtration classifications have a complete elementary all-dimensional proof. Finite subgroup enumeration for dimensions 3 through 6 corroborates the proof; independent audit has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: The theorem treats nontrivial binary coordinate-translation subgroups only, at scales zero through two; it does not classify fixed sets for general coordinate permutations, nor higher-scale geometry. No novel nonequivariant sphere-wedge classification is asserted.
title: Translation-subgroup fixed-point persistence of scale-two hypercube Vietoris–Rips complexes
